_readme: Hand-maintained source for scripts/build-world-map.mjs. Facts rule (CLAUDE.md): a pin renders as verified only when verified=true. Set verified=true only after reading the venue on the event's own race site (public/data/past_races.json URLs; private race-site repos in the f1tenth org when the public site is down) or the conference site. Unverified pins render as hollow rings with a mono 'tbc' tag; never silently drop them. number = the official 'Nth RoboRacer Autonomous Racing Competition' from the race site title where it exists (ICRA 2026 = 27th, IV 2026 = 28th, IFAC 2026 = 29th, VTC 2026 = 30th, IROS 2026 = 31st). kind: race | madgames | workshop | course. status: held | upcoming | virtual.
